candidate: An uncontrollable appearance difference in a goal image is incorrectly treated as achievable action-dependent progress by a frozen visual world-model planner.
reason: The current proposal overlaps directly with published controllability factorization, common-mode rejection and documented spurious nuisance-action interactions. A frozen latent metric based on real/predicted action-response fidelity is also described in a current primary-source submission abstract. No distinct implementable security operation has been identified.

primary_sources.title: CF-JEPA: Improving Robustness of JEPA World Models via Controllability Factorization
primary_sources.verified_scope: Primary abstract, full text and project page
primary_sources.overlap: Separate controllable and uncontrollable representations; action-conditioned versus action-free prediction; goal-image CEM uses the controllable representation.
primary_sources.caveat: The project page and paper differ in the alpha/beta hyperparameter description. Do not infer exact reproduction settings from the project page alone. Author results have not been independently reproduced here.

primary_sources.title: Dueling World Models: Advantage-Style Action Channels for Common-Mode Distractor Rejection
primary_sources.verified_scope: Primary abstract and full text including appendices
primary_sources.relevant_location: Section 3; Appendix I (Scope of the Claim); Appendix H (Extended Discussion)
primary_sources.overlap: Action-mean centering applies to frozen predictors. Appendix I explicitly distinguishes physically action-independent nuisances from a learned nuisance-by-action interaction; a zero-mean interaction survives centering.
primary_sources.caveat: The paper's control evidence has stated limits, including a failed DMC control gate. Algebraic cancellation does not guarantee successful planning or a nuisance-free learned action channel. Author experiments have not been independently reproduced here.

primary_sources.title: Latent Metrics for Planning with World Models
primary_sources.venue_status: ICLR 2027 Conference Submission; acceptance not established
primary_sources.verified_scope: Exact title, forum ID, submission number, venue status and abstract retrieved from the official OpenReview API
primary_sources.overlap: With encoder and predictor frozen, the abstract proposes weighting latent planning directions using real-versus-predicted action-response consistency and prediction accuracy; it explicitly describes a fixed-candidate, fixed-prediction ranking comparison.
primary_sources.caveat: Full PDF/forum content could not be accessed in this audit. Specific equations, tasks, data partitions and result tables are unverified. Abstract results are author claims and are not our experiments.

local_architecture_boundary.prediction_inputs: Current encoded observation and candidate action sequence
local_architecture_boundary.goal_path: Goal encoding enters the planning objective, not the world predictor
local_architecture_boundary.implication: Changing only the goal cannot change forecasts for fixed observations and fixed candidate actions in this implementation. Ranking changes alone would not establish forecast contamination.
